title: Ops hotlist scrub - March 2026
content:
Purpose: lightweight cross-team hotlist to surface items needing rapid unblock or 1:1 alignment. Not a long-term tracker; reset after next ops scrub (weekly).

Legend: P0=blocker, P1=high, P2=normal, P3=low | Status: open/in-progress/wont-do/closed | ETA in business days where possible

Columns: Item	Owner	Team(s)	Priority	Status	Blockers / Next step	ETA	Notes / context	Jira
1) Dedicated capacity spool up - verify region fails when autoscale spikes	Miguel Torres	eng-dedicated, infra	P0	in-progress	API gateway config mismatch; infra needs cert rotation + canary rule change	3 days	Observed 5x latency spikes when burst > 2 nodes; need emergency change; propose maintenance window Fri 3/12 02:00-04:00 UTC	INFRA-3302
2) Embeddings cost regression alert (prod)	Sofia Martinez	observability, product-hosted-api	P1	open	root cause suspected: recent batching change in runtime; need p95 traces and token-level cost delta	5 days	Interim: throttle bulk-embed jobs from analytics pipeline; notify customers impacted	OBS-1181
3) Private deploy onboarding checklist gap (KMS docs)	Dana Chen	private-deployments, security	P2	in-progress	Missing HSM integration step in ops-runbook; SEC needs sample terraform + diagram	7 days	Add link to sample policy in private-deployments repo; owner assigned for docs	PD-207
4) Console route-level cost dashboard mismatch	Aisha Kapoor	console-and-rollouts, observability	P1	open	ETL job failing for STG; product-ops to triage with eng-observability	2 days	Some routes show negative cost delta after merge of usage-metrics PR; likely tagging mismatch	CONSOLE-92
5) Customer X performance SLA exception (short term)	Customer Success (lead: Maya)	customer-success, solutions-engineering	P0	open	Need temp capacity allocation + escalation to Dedicated capacity team	1 day	CS asked for 99.9% target; currently 98.5% for one route during peak PST evenings; CS wants a mitigation plan	CS-5289
6) Quick headcount and budget ask for FY27 planning	Ethan Park	product-ops, finance-and-legal	P2	open	Finance needs where to shave 10% in infra OPEX vs committed reserved capacity	10 days	Collect proposals from platform-eng and serving-runtime; quick table below	FIN-ops-request-2026

Mini table: proposed infra OPEX trims (one-off asks)
Option	Estimated monthly saving	Risk summary	Owner
Delay non-critical Dedicated expansions	$45k	Capacity tightness in EMEA; potential customer impact for mid-market	platform-eng
Reduce embedding retention to 7 days (from 30) for non-PRO accounts	$18k	Loss of historical re-embedding; affects analytics only	observability
Short-term increase auto-evict idle batches threshold	$6k	May increase tail latency for bursty traffic	serving-runtime

Quick actions (for next 48h):
- [ ] Miguel to propose maintenance window + rollback plan for gateway change (due 3/10 EOD)
- [ ] Sofia to run token-cost diff and attach CSV to OBS-1181 (due 3/11)
- [ ] Aisha to re-run dashboard ETL on staging and paste logs here (in sheet)
- [ ] Ethan to consolidate 3 budget proposals into single table for FY27 planning sync (due 3/12)

Open questions / notes to self:
- Does PD runbook template include a KMS HSM section? (I think not) -> tag SEC for review before Friday
- Can we temporarily route Customer X to Dedicated spare slot? Check Dedicated pool utilization (SLO: keep spare <= 10%)
- Consider short-lived badge in console for routes under SLA exception so CS can surface to customer success managers

Meeting cadence: weekly ops-hotlist scrub; adhoc deep-dive for P0s (30 min) -> owners add 1:1 time if ETA slips more than 48h

History: created as a one-off after ops standup 2026-03-09 to capture cross-team asks that didn't fit in Jira process. Intend to triage and then turn high-priority items into tracked tickets.

Contact: Dana Chen (product-ops) — ping in #ops-hotlist or DM for rapid unblocks.

End of sheet.
